Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

frequency connectors, BNC, TNC and UHF series: Part 1 Test schedule and requirements'.

IS:11075 (Part 1)-1984] as given in Table 1.

4. Mating Interface Dimensions — See Fig. 1 of IS: 11075(Part 1)-1984 for mating interface dimensions. 

5. Materials, Finish and Life — The material, finish and life requirement shall be as under. 

a) Materia/ 

1) Body — Loaded brass conforming to 13:319-1974 Tree cutting brass bars, rods and sections 

(third revision) or 13:531-1971 'Leaded brass strip for instrument parts (second 
revision)'. 

2) Centre contact — Loaded brass conforming to 13:319-1974 or 13:531-1971. 

3) Insulation material — PTFE. 

4) Gaskets 

i) For professional grade — Silicon rubber, 
ji) For consumer grade — Neoprene rubber. 

b) Finish 

1) Professional grade 

i) Centre contact — 1-27 microns minimum gold plated over 5 microns minimum nickel or 
copper under plate. 

ji) Other metal parts — 5 microns minimum silver or nickel plated. Braid clamps shall be 
silver plated 5 microns minimum. 

2) Consumer grade 

All metal parts minimum silver or nickel plated except centre contact and braid clamp to 
be silver plated 5 microns minimum. 

c) iVIechanical Life 

500 mating cycles for pairs at 12 cycles/min (/Wax). 

6. Climatic Category 

a) Temperature severity 

1) Professional grade — —65 to +200°C 

2) Consumer grade — —10 to +70^ 

b) Damp heat severity — 56 days 

c) Air pressure (low) — 4-4 kPa 

d) Acceleration (steady state) — 170 m/s^ 

e) Vibration — 10 to 2 000 Hz 

f) Shock — 500 m/s2 

7. Mating Characteristics 

a) Contact with spring members 

All slotted members shall contact a 8-23 mm (M/n). Diameter ring within 0-79 mm of their 
tip ends. 

b) Outer contact 

1) Test ring 10:8-1 mm (l\/lax), 

2) Test ring finish :0-4 microns. 

3) Insertion Force: 22-25 N (Max) when inserted a minimum of 2-36 mm. 

2 



IS : 11075 ( Part 2/Sec 3 ) - 1985 

8. Mechanical Characteristics 

a) Engagement and Disengagement Force 

1) Longitudinal Force — 13-35 N Max 

2) Torque — 2 83 mN m Max 

b) Centre Contact Retention Force — Not applicable 

c) Cable Retention Force 

1) Non-crimp assemblies — 178 N {Mm) 

2) Crimp assembleis 

222-50 N (M/n) for cables 3-94 to 4-80 mm CD. 
267 N (Mm) for cables 4-81 to 5-82 mm CD. 
333-75 N {Mm) for cables 5-83 to 6-33 mm CD. 
400-50 N {Mm) for cables 6-34 mm CD and larger. 

d) Coupling mechanism retention force: 445 N (M/n). 

9. Electrical Characteristics 

a) Corona 

1) Corona level — 375 V (M/n) at 4-4 kPa (low air pressure). 

2) Cable length — 152-4 cm. 

b) Voltage Rating 

1) At sea level — 500 V rms {Max). 

2) At low air pressure — 125 V rms {Max). 

c) Characteristic Impedance — See Table 1 

d) Frequency range — DC to 4 GHz 

e) VSWR — 1-3 maximum at 500 MHz to 4 GHz 

f) RF Leakage —55 dB minimum at frequencies between 2 and 3 GHz 

g) RF Insertion Loss — 0-3 db at 3 GHz 
h) RF Voltage Proof 

1) Voltage and frequency — 1 000 V rms at 5 to 7-5 MHz. 

2) Leakage current — Not applicable. 

10. Tests — See 8 of 18:11075 (Part 1)-1984. 

11. Marking — See 5 of 18:11075 (Part 1)-1984. 



EXPLANATO RY NOTE 

This standard is based on J88 52401. 'Detail specification for connectors, radio frequency, series 
BNC, TNC and UHF'. The types of connectors covered in this standard are equivalent to Pattern 
J8S 52401/03.
